lean-challenge-snapshot.sh --dry-run reads EVERY backticked token in the plan's Goals block as a Goal identifier (it reported RladAdm, abbrev, gPast_adm, snce as 'named in Goals but not declared'); worked around by de-backticking every non-goal token in that block. A planner authoring a lean4 plan must keep the Goals block's backticks to the goal identifiers only.
